sections.title: Personal income tax (személyi jövedelemadó, SZJA)

source.title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról (Personal Income Tax Act), version in force from 1 October 2026, § 8

sections.basis: Consolidated tax base (összevont adóalap), per year
sections.note: One flat rate on wages, self-employment income and other consolidated income; there is no tax-free allowance for everyone. The allowances below reduce the tax base in the order set by § 29/H.

sections.title: Tax base allowances (adóalap-kedvezmények): family, first marriage, personal

rows.label: Family allowance (családi kedvezmény), 1 dependant: per beneficiary dependant per month
rows.note: saves HUF 20,001 of tax a month

rows.label: Family allowance, 2 dependants: per beneficiary dependant per month
rows.note: saves HUF 39,999 of tax a month per child

rows.label: Family allowance, 3 or more dependants: per beneficiary dependant per month
rows.note: saves HUF 66,000 of tax a month per child

rows.label: Family allowance supplement for a long-term ill or severely disabled child, per month
Family contribution credit (családi járulékkedvezmény): share of the unused family allowance
rows.note: reduces the employee's 18.5% contribution (or the 10% pension contribution) when the tax base is too small

source.title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények (personal income tax base allowances), published 19 March 2026, section 11

rows.label: First-marriage allowance (első házasok kedvezménye), per couple per month
rows.note: saves HUF 5,000 of tax a month; at least one spouse in a first marriage, no age limit

source.title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/C

rows.note: one third of the minimum wage rounded to HUF 100; saves HUF 16,140 of tax a month

source.title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/E

rows.label: Order of the allowances (§ 29/H)
rows.value: 1. mothers under 30; 2. mothers of four or more, three or two children; 3. CSED, GYED and adoption benefit allowance; 4. under-25 allowance; 5. personal allowance; 6. first-marriage allowance; 7. family allowance

source.title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról, version in force from 1 October 2026, § 29/H

sections.note: Allowances reduce the tax base, so each forint of allowance saves 15 fillér of tax. The family allowance counts dependants (e.g. students) but is claimed only for beneficiary dependants, and spouses or partners may share it.

rows.note: EEA nationals and nationals of non-EEA neighbouring countries; employment and listed self-employment income

rows.label: Mothers under 30 (30 év alatti anyák kedvezménye)
rows.value: Exempt with no upper limit from 2026: mothers entitled to the family allowance for their own or adopted child (or a foetus from day 91), until the year they turn 30

source.title: NAV information booklet 73: Szja adóalap-kedvezmények, published 19 March 2026, section 2 (30 év alatti anyák kedvezménye)

rows.label: Mothers of four or more children (NÉTAK)
rows.value: Exempt with no upper limit on employment and listed self-employment income

rows.value: Exempt with no upper limit from 1 October 2025; the Act sets no age condition

rows.value: From 1 January 2026, no upper limit, phased in by age: in 2026 mothers under 40 (born in 1986 or later), from 2027 under 50, from 2028 under 60, from 2029 all ages

source.title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 2025. évi XIV. törvény a két gyermeket nevelő anyák kedvezményéről (Act XIV of 2025 on the allowance for mothers raising two children), version in force from 1 January 2026, § 3-4
